top.en:
This probability ladder of a journey stopped at 0.10%.
Starting from 65.3% in the Nirvana group, breaking through the Knight's Road, securing a Worlds spot against 4.1% odds, relying on a 0.7% chance to reach the quarterfinals, and fighting all the way to the semifinals. The microscopic goal of reaching the finals and winning the championship was ultimately unreachable.
Few people believed in this team coming out of the trough, and with every step forward, the odds shrank. They fought hard game after game, turning cold numbers into the real path beneath their feet. Miracles are rare by nature, and stopping at the semifinals is a pity, but Nirvana is not just about winning the championship.
Fighting until the very last moment is moving enough. 0.10% is the answer sheet iG handed in. Every step brings new possibilities, you've worked hard.
